sources.title: MobileNet V3 — Torchvision main documentation
sources.snippet: MobileNet V3 ¶ The MobileNet V3 model is based on the Searching for MobileNetV3 paper. Model builders ¶ The following model builders can be used to instantiate a MobileNetV3 model, with or without pre-trained weights. All the model builders internally rely on the torchvision.models.mobilenetv3.MobileNetV3 base class. Please refer to the source code for more details about this class.
